title: Guardrails
purpose: Limit responses strictly to the provided documents or knowledge base.
benefit: Ensures accuracy, control, and prevents hallucinations from the model.

title: Context Memory
purpose: Enable the chatbot to retain conversation context across turns.
benefit: Allows natural multi-turn conversations without repeating context.

title: Reference Citing
purpose: Display the source or excerpt the chatbot used to generate the answer.
benefit: Builds trust by showing where information comes from.

title: Adaptive Learning
purpose: Adjust response style based on user interaction patterns.

title: Dynamic Prompt Engineering
purpose: Detect query intent and modify the system prompt automatically.
benefit: Improves response quality by tailoring prompts to question type.

title: Multi-Model Comparison Mode
purpose: Enable users to send the same query to multiple AI models and compare outputs.
benefit: Helps evaluate model performance and find the best fit for specific tasks.

title: Summary Format
purpose: Control the output format of summaries (bullets, paragraphs, action items).
benefit: Adapts summaries to different use cases and preferences.

title: Key Point Extraction
purpose: Automatically extract key points and action items from documents.
benefit: Saves time by highlighting what matters most.

title: Data Visualization
purpose: Generate charts and graphs from data analysis results.
benefit: Makes patterns and insights visually accessible.

title: Pattern Detection
purpose: Automatically detect trends and anomalies in data.
benefit: Surfaces insights that might be missed in manual analysis.

title: Plan Review
purpose: Show the agent's plan before execution for human approval.
benefit: Gives control over what the agent will do before it acts.

title: Step Tracing
purpose: Display each step the agent takes during execution.
benefit: Provides transparency into agent reasoning and actions.

title: Parallel Execution
purpose: Send the same prompt to multiple models simultaneously.
benefit: Faster comparison by running requests in parallel.

title: Cost Tracking
purpose: Show token usage and cost for each model response.
benefit: Helps evaluate cost-effectiveness of different models.

title: Quality Judge
purpose: Use an AI judge to score each response for relevance, accuracy, and quality.
benefit: Adds objective quality scores alongside cost and speed metrics.
